_comment: Phase 67 — NEXUS MCP Tool Bridge config for Claude Desktop
_instructions: 1. Copy this file's 'mcpServers' section into your Claude Desktop config
3. Start NEXUS before opening Claude Desktop
4. The MCP server starts automatically when Guardian boots on :7821

_tools: nexus_copilot      — ask the co-pilot anything (7-layer context, zero grep)
nexus_status       — health of all NEXUS services
nexus_gaps         — open structural gaps by severity
nexus_cfr          — CFR-Ω field: sigma, regime, coherence
nexus_build_organism — describe an organism, get a FORGE build plan
nexus_read_spec    — read a spec file by name
